# Behance

> > Behance is Adobe's leading platform for creative professionals to showcase portfolios, discover talent, and connect with career opportunities.

Behance serves as a comprehensive ecosystem for the creative community, offering portfolio hosting, a freelance marketplace, asset licensing, and Pro membership features. The platform connects designers, illustrators, photographers, and other creatives with clients, collaborators, and career opportunities while integrating with Adobe Portfolio and other creative tools.

## Key Topics

- Creative portfolios
- Freelance marketplace
- Behance Pro membership
- Client discovery
- Asset marketplace
- Designer community
- Creative careers
- Adobe Portfolio integration
- Talent discovery
- Project showcasing
- Creative networking
- Work-for-hire opportunities
- Creative licensing
- Portfolio optimization

- [About Behance](https://www.behance.net/about): Behance platform overview: creative portfolio, marketplace, and careers
